extension.summary: Service presets, logos and custom services for the Backlot skin.
extension.description: Builds the service tiles for the Backlot skin from the studios and networks in your library. Turn presets on or off, reorder them, add your own services, set custom art, and export or import your setup.
extension.news: v0.6.4 - Letter jump for the library lists. v0.6.3 - Change order now includes the Movies, Collections and TV Shows tiles. v0.6.2 - Shows opened from TMDb Helper info screens still go home on Back. v0.6.1 - Logos for UK TV, PBS, Telemundo, MGM+ and Crunchyroll. v0.6.0 - Networks: NBC, CBS, ABC, FOX, Telemundo, A&E, History, Lifetime, MGM+ and the UK channels can have their own tiles, stay inside their streaming service, or both. New Starz, PBS, Univision and Crunchyroll presets. British is now UK TV. Network tiles only appear when you have titles from them. v0.5.1 - New Collections tile logo. v0.5.0 - Each movie collection stays under one service (the one with most of its movies), optional Collections tile after Movies, Max renamed HBO Max. v0.4.9 - Collection artwork pass is much lighter on big libraries: it skips collections it already checked, waits for library scans to finish and starts 30 seconds after Kodi. v0.4.8 - Up Next install from Backlot settings and setup (step 10 of 13). v0.4.6 - Fuller studio lists per service, Discovery+ inside Max, one-step services from the studios report.
